messages:
jordan: Hey team — I pushed changes that address all review comments from yesterday. Split the flaky tests into a separate fixture, moved the helper into pkg/util, and fixed the linter warnings. PTAL when you have a moment.

alana: Thanks — skimmed, looks much cleaner. One nit: rename `resp` -> `response` in grpc_test.go? Otherwise LGTM. :+1:

jordan: Good catch, renamed and pushed. Also updated the smoke script to avoid the race. See `tools/smoke.sh`.

sam: Quick Q: the CI flake you mentioned — was that the test timeout? Did you add a retry wrapper or just increased timeout?

jordan: It was the timeout. I added a lightweight retry decorator around the external call and restored the original timeout. Small change, included in the last commit.

lee: I can give this one an approval if someone else also eyes the rollout config. Who will own the merge?

jordan: I can be merge owner. Plan is to merge in the 11:30 PST window after a quick smoke run. Will hold if anyone objects.

olivia: One question on rollout: can we canary to 10% traffic first? If yes, please add a short rollback note.

jordan: Yep — added `rollout: { strategy: canary, initial: 10, monitor: 5m }` to the deployment config and a rollback step in the runbook. Pushed.

lee: LGTM :thumbsup: I can be one of the two eyes.

sam: I reviewed the changed test fixtures and the retry wrapper — looks fine to me. +1 on merging once smoke passes.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2024-04-10T19:30:00Z (11:30 PST). Notification will follow when canary completes.

jordan: Running the quick smoke: `./tools/smoke.sh --quick` now. If that passes I'll merge in ~10m. Thanks everyone for the fast review. :rocket:

lee: Smoke passed on my run. No regressions observed.

sam: Same here, smoke green.

jordan: Merging now and will monitor the canary logs for 10m. If anything odd appears I'll roll back and post here. Thanks all.
